sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Satinder Singh Bawa, APP  the State with SI Naresh K  SI Shivam Sahu  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 26.02.2026

1. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 104/2019 of Police Station Krishna Nagar, Delhi for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no. 2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
2. Statements of parties have already been recorded by the Joint Registrar but according to respondent no. 2, a sum of Rs. 50,000/- out of the settlement amount is outstanding.
The same be paid by the next date.
